Name: NASA Space Live Tracker
Author: Ratpack

Actions.Name: ISS Overhead
Actions.Tooltip: Tracks the International Space Station. Pulses white and says OVERHEAD when it passes near you.

Actions.Name: Next Launch
Actions.Tooltip: Countdown to the next orbital rocket launch. Press to cycle the next three launches.

Actions.Name: Picture of the Day
Actions.Tooltip: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day, refreshed each morning. Press to open it full size.

Description: Track the ISS overhead, count down to the next rocket launch, and see NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day — right on your Stream Deck.
